zh: 共享对话支持停止共享收回模式与按需技能申请：发起者停止共享或移除成员时自动收回并清理非发起者副本及共享附件（同步清理存量残留副本）；共享历史里缺失的私有技能改为仅在主动触发或调用时才弹窗申请授权，平时不再常驻顶栏打扰。
优化默认指标检索范围与多数据源引导：未明确指定表名时默认通过卡片先提供 2 个最常用入口 +「其他业务表（按常用顺序选择）」，点击「其他」后再按高频使用顺序引导选表；同时为数据库与表名标注中文用途与行数详情，避免全库盲扫几百张表。
受限及非超管账号在对话中选择工作区目录时，统一以相对工作区根目录的 ~ 路径展示，不再暴露宿主机完整路径。
移动端（iOS / Android）支持在侧栏长按拖拽调整置顶对话顺序。
en: Shared conversations now revoke and purge non-owner local copies and shared attachments when sharing stops or members are removed (including legacy stopped shares), and only prompt to request missing private skills on demand when actually triggered or used.

Focused default metric/data lookup scope: instead of scanning hundreds of tables, present a 2-option + "Other tables (ordered by common usage)" picker card that guides users through prioritized business tables in a follow-up step, paired with database/table purpose labels and row counts.
Display workspace directory paths relative to each user's workspace root (~) instead of full host paths for confined and non-superadmin accounts in the local folder picker.
Added drag-to-reorder support for pinned conversations in the mobile sidebar (iOS & Android).
